name: Whip pan left
summary: Energy and surprise; joins two beats as if they were one thought, hides a cut inside the blur, comedic timing.

data.about: A pan so fast the middle of it is a streak of motion blur; the camera leaves one composition and lands hard on another.
data.avoid: Quiet or sincere beats; more than one or two per film; small screens where the blur reads as a glitch.
